tandemFrageBeispiel.frage: Como se diz em conversa: «O ministro chegara na véspera»?
tandemFrageBeispiel.antwort: O ministro tinha chegado na véspera.

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Como se diz em conversa: «Quando cheguei, ele já saíra»?”

B hears the question and builds the answer. There are two directions. In conversation the past before a past is tinha + participle (ter is the blue verb: tinha, tinham, tínhamos). In a newspaper or a novel it is the simple mais-que-perfeito: take the eles form of the pretérito perfeito, drop -ram and add -ra, -ras, -ra, -ramos (with an accent), -ram: dissera, fizera, fora (ser or ir), recebêramos. A tile in brackets, like (ele), says who; it is not written.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Finally: swap cards and do it all again, faster.
